Title: SQL Server Data Tools is now available with Visual Studio 2019 Preview

Body.Content:
SQL Server Data Tools preview for Azure SQL Data Warehouse is now downloadable with the latest preview release of Visual Studio 2019. SQL Server Data Tools enables a stable change management and deployment experience when developing your data analytics solution using SQL Data Warehouse.

Read this documentation to set up a simple continuous integration and deployment pipeline:

  • Install Visual Studio 2019 Preview
  • Integrate with source control
  • Continuous integration and deployment

If you have questions or would like to provide feedback on SQL Server Data Tools, please email us.
